title: Flashcard Cram Drill from Gemini Pro
description: A two-prompt Gemini Pro source run produced a single-file flashcard cram drill where students can paste notes, add and edit cards, quiz with hard/easy review states, persist decks locally, and use JSON export/import controls.
model_settings: Gemini web UI; selected 3.1 Pro from the mode picker (option label: 3.1 Pro, Advanced math and code). Current mode control displayed Pro. Thinking level Standard was visible in the picker. No uploads or external tools used.
source_url_note: Real Gemini conversation URL captured from the authorized logged-in Chrome session; not a public share URL.
final_artifact_clue: Single self-contained HTML study tool titled Cram Drill; final/default artifact is the fixed version with visible Edit, Save, and Cancel controls.

artifact_versions.notes: First real artifact version. Verified as nonblank and mostly functional, but rejected as final because existing cards only had Delete and could not be edited.
Final artifact version. Adds visible Edit, Save, and Cancel controls while preserving paste/import, add card, cram quiz, hard/easy marking, localStorage, and JSON import/export code.

verification_notes: Verified locally over HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:8786/public/artifacts/flashcard-cram-gemini-31-pro.html on 2026-06-04. V1 rendered, bulk-imported three Front | Back notes, persisted deck data, and supported quiz hard/easy marking, but lacked edit controls, so a natural fix prompt was sent. Final artifact reloaded with the imported cards from localStorage, showed Edit buttons, opened inline Front/Back edit fields with Save and Cancel, saved an edited Photosynthesis card, preserved that edit after reload, added a new single card, entered Cram Mode, flipped via Show Answer, marked Hard to keep the queue at 4 cards, marked Easy to reduce it to 3 cards, and had no console error logs. Export button click produced no console errors; the Chrome automation did not observe a download event, so export/import support was additionally verified statically via data:text/json download code, cram_drill_deck.json filename, import-file input, FileReader JSON parsing, and saveDeck/localStorage calls.
result_content: Self-contained flashcard cram drill with bulk note parsing, single-card creation, inline editing, hard/easy quiz queue, localStorage persistence, and JSON export/import controls.
agent_notes: Source-run package only. Do not approve, publish, create a public prompt/upvote page, or create votes/comments/bookmarks during intake. Provider/model/settings: Gemini 3.1 Pro, mode picker option labeled Advanced math and code, Thinking level Standard. Prompt count: 2. Prompt 2 was a natural fix after V1 lacked card editing. Final artifact: public/artifacts/flashcard-cram-gemini-31-pro.html. Artifact versions: V1 plus final fixed HTML. Source URL: https://gemini.google.com/app/22eaad7a9a49ec21. Verification passed locally. Uploaded by the manager as queued source-run intake 3dbee174-f631-458c-bd01-2560ea3fac3f under non-admin profile pathforge-seed-012 / SofiaPatel / Sofia Patel. No public page was created or published by this importer.

recommended_seed_profile.rationale: User requested a realistic non-admin seed profile recommendation and preferred pathforge-seed-012 if needed. Registry was not edited because this builder lane did not upload/submit.

steps.prompt_exact: Make me a polished single-file HTML flashcard cram drill for students where I can paste notes, create and edit cards, quiz myself, mark cards easy or hard, save locally, and export/import the deck.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a self-contained flashcard cram drill with bulk Front | Back note import, add-card fields, localStorage, a flip-card cram mode, hard/easy marking, and JSON export/import code, but no actual edit controls for existing cards.
